title: Script scan rules: from core scripts to first-class scan rules
description: How active and passive scripts became scan rules: script scanners in the core from 2013, their move to the scripts add-on in 2023 and 2024, and scripts treated as first-class scan rules from scripts 45.2.0.

chapters.title: Active and passive scripts in core, 2013 to 2015
chapters.text: The 2013-07-15 commit "Issue 735: Move script support into the core" adds ScriptsActiveScanner.java, ScriptsPassiveScanner.java, ActiveScript.java and PassiveScript.java, with active-template.js and passive-template.js. On 2015-02-24 zaproxy has "Issue 1541 : Enable active scan scripts to scan just a URL rather than every parameter".

chapters.title: Moved from core to the scripts add-on, 2023 to 2024
chapters.text: On 2023-12-27 zaproxy has "Deprecate Script Scan Rules and related classes", whose message says "These will be made available as part of the scripts add-on." On 2023-12-30 zap-extensions has "scripts: Migrate scan rule functionality from core". The scripts changelog for 45.0.0 (2024-02-12) says "The scan rule functionality of scripts was moved from the ZAP core to this add-on (Related to Issue 7105)." Both commits are by ricekot.

chapters.title: First-class scan rules, 2024
chapters.text: On 2024-03-26 zap-extensions merges pull request #5322 from ricekot/scripts/scan-rules, with the commit "Expose Active & Passive Scripts as Scan Rules". The changelog for 45.2.0 (2024-04-11) says "Active and Passive Scripts with a getMetadata() function are now treated as first-class scan rules (Issue 7105)." 45.3.0 (2024-05-07) adds code and help links for script scan rules and raises the minimum ZAP version to 2.15.0.

chapters.title: The announcement, 2024-07-17
chapters.text: The blog post "ZAP Scripts are now Full Scan Rules!" by Akshath Kothari opens "ZAP active and passive scripts are now first-class scan rules!" It says any active or passive script that implements a getMetadata function is exposed as a scan rule, that each such script needs a unique ID or it will not be loaded, and that all passive scripts and most active scripts in the community-scripts repository were updated to implement getMetadata().

evidence.label: ZAP Scripts are now Full Scan Rules! (2024-07-17)

chapters.title: Later additions, 2025
chapters.text: The scripts changelog lists support for alert reference overrides in script scan rule metadata (45.14.0, 2025-10-07), a scanHost method for active script scan rules called once per host (45.15.0, 2025-11-04), and a fix for script scan rules not using the attack strength and alert threshold from active scan policies (45.16.0, 2025-12-03). The commits "scripts: Support alertRefOverrides in scan rule metadata" (2025-10-07) and "scripts: Support `scanHost` method in active scripts" (2025-10-17) are by ricekot.
